verdict.rationale: Lambda's filesystem docs describe an adapter that lets S3-compatible tools like rclone and s5cmd copy files to and from its regional filesystems, which covers the S3-compatible-endpoint and documented-tooling core of the story. Filesystems are attachable for storing datasets, and MK8s provides shared persistent storage. Missing for 10: detail on the S3 adapter's endpoints, authentication and performance; any native cloud-storage sync to or from external clouds; independent or hands-on corroboration of transfer efficiency.
